roleTitle: Senior Quality Operations Specialist, Mobility Services Platform
jobDescription: The mobility services platform runs ride, courier and rental services for a regional operator. The Senior Quality Operations Specialist owns the quality audit programme for driver and courier partners: audit sampling, case review, corrective-action tracking and the monthly quality report. The role requires a senior specialist with at least four years in operations quality or auditing; a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or ISO 9001 internal auditor qualification is required.
requirements: Senior specialist with at least four years of experience in operations quality, auditing or a comparable field.
Holds a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or ISO 9001 internal auditor qualification.
Runs the partner quality audit programme, including sampling, case review and corrective-action tracking.
Prepares the monthly quality report for the operations director and records own responsibility boundaries.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions at the end of each audit cycle.

evidence.text: Senior Quality Operations Specialist for five years and two months at a regional mobility operator, promoted from quality specialist after the first eighteen months; led the partner quality audit programme covering about 900 driver and courier partners.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (certified by the operator's accredited programme provider, certificate number on file) and ISO 9001:2015 internal auditor course completed with the certification body.

Ran the audit programme's quarterly sampling, the case review sessions with the partner managers and the corrective-action tracker, closing actions with the regional managers within the agreed deadlines.
Prepared the monthly quality report for the operations director, covering audit results, open corrective actions and repeat findings; the director decided any partner suspensions.
Responsibilities included audit sampling, case review, corrective-action tracking and monthly reporting for the partner quality programme.

Work sample: one quarter's audit sampling plan and corrective-action tracker extract (partner id, finding, action, owner, due date, closure date) and the corresponding monthly report, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.

Reference call with former operations director: confirmed the senior title, the promotion date, five years and two months of employment and that the Green Belt was completed through the operator's programme.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate holds a valid driving licence and can travel to regional hubs; notice period is six weeks.

propositions.text: The candidate ran the partner quality audit programme, including quarterly sampling, case review sessions and the corrective-action tracker.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the programme activities.

propositions.text: The candidate prepared the monthly quality report for the operations director, who decided any partner suspensions.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the reporting and the decision boundary.

propositions.text: The candidate is a Senior Quality Operations Specialist with five years and two months of experience and holds a Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the senior title, the duration and the certification, and the reference call confirms all three.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions at the end of each audit cycle are only partly documented in the materials.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the seniority, duration and certification exactly as the resume and reference state them; do not extend the ISO 9001 course into a lead-auditor qualification.
followUpTargets: Ask how known limitations and hand-over conditions were recorded at the end of each audit cycle.
